lines.t: In a kingdom far away, where the shadows grew so tall,
A humble girl was chosen from the least among them all.
She wore a crown of purpose, not of pride or greed,
For God had placed her presence there to meet a deeper need.
For such a time as this, she stood with faith and grace,
When fear was at the door, she sought the Father’s face.
Her courage lit the darkness, her prayers broke through the mist,
She rose to save her people, for such a time as this.
Before the throne of power, her trembling heart would pray,
“If I must perish, I will go,” her faith would lead the way.
No sword nor silver promised what her God could do,
He turned their mourning into joy, and mercy saw them through.
For such a time as this, she stood with faith and grace,
When fear was at the door, she sought the Father’s face.
Her courage lit the darkness, her prayers broke through the mist,
She rose to save her people, for such a time as this.
God’s plan was never hidden, His promise never failed,
Through Esther’s quiet bravery, His victory prevailed.
When all seemed lost and hopeless, His hand was working still,
He lifted one who trusted Him to do His perfect will.
For such a time as this, we’re called to stand and shine,
To walk in truth and mercy, to live His grand design.
Like Esther in the moment, we’re chosen, loved, and His—
To change the world with courage, for such a time as this.
